whatMakesDifferent.text: With an average student to teacher ratio of 6.3, risevana teachers have the time and space to genuinely know every learner.
They remember your child is working on being braver about sharing ideas. They sit with the big questions.
16 nationalities, taught in big cities, small villages, international schools and camps.
18 days of professional development every year. Weekly peer reviews. Continuous feedback.

hero.title: Our Story: Bridging the Divide
hero.subtitle: Risevana was founded on a simple truth: no child should have to risk their safety or cross a dangerous river just to attend school.

story: In rural Rwanda, children often walked miles through rugged terrain, sometimes having to navigate swollen rivers during the rainy season to reach basic classrooms. Risevana Foundation was created to bring high quality, joyful education directly into the hearts of rural communities.
Today, we combine physical community ECD classrooms with innovative solar-powered mobile digital literacy labs, bringing modern education and nutritious meals to over 1,200 young learners.
